title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Documents Due Date Falling on a Weekend
content:
On a documents request under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, a weekend move is added to the response days last: when the request date plus all the response days counted so far falls on a Saturday, the response days grow by two; when it falls on a Sunday, by one; otherwise by none. The documents due date therefore moves from a Saturday or a Sunday to the following Monday.

| Day reached by the request date plus the response days counted so far | Response days grow by |
|---|---|
| Saturday | 2 |
| Sunday | 1 |
| Monday to Friday | 0 |

**Worked dates (hypothetical; request issued Monday 7 September 2026).**
- Response days counted so far 33: the day reached is Saturday 10 October 2026; the response days become 35 and the due date is Monday 12 October 2026.
- Response days counted so far 34: the day reached is Sunday 11 October 2026; the response days become 35 and the due date is Monday 12 October 2026.
- Response days counted so far 30: the day reached is Wednesday 7 October 2026; no move.
